name: BOFFIN business-quality rubric (Axelrod edition)
note: Scores are -1, 0, +1, or null (N/A). Thresholds are one practitioner's calibration, so the UI should say 'score under this framework', never 'objective quality'. Valuation is deliberately not scored. Labels and anchors are paraphrased for this repo.

strategy.label: Strategy
strategy.evidence_hint: Stated strategy in the 10-K business section and investor materials, and whether actions match it.

demand_side.label: Demand side
demand_side.evidence_hint: A named mechanism for why customers stay (switching costs, network effects). A famous brand is not evidence.

supply_side.label: Supply side
supply_side.evidence_hint: A named cost or scale advantage, supplier concentration, input risk.

flywheel.label: Flywheel
flywheel.evidence_hint: A reinforcing loop with evidence for each link.

rotic_vs_peers.label: ROTIC vs peers
rotic_vs_peers.evidence_hint: Company ROTIC against peer ROTICs computed the same way, from the same kind of source.

secular_growth.label: Secular growth
secular_growth.evidence_hint: Industry growth evidence from market reports and filings.

rotic_level.label: ROTIC level (10y)
rotic_level.evidence_hint: NOPAT / average TICAP, framework definitions below. Fewer than 10 years of data means confidence low.

capital_allocation.label: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.evidence_hint: Stated capital allocation framework and what was actually done with cash.

share_repo_record.label: Share repurchase record
share_repo_record.evidence_hint: Buybacks against share count and price over time.

mgmt_fit.label: Management fit
mgmt_fit.plus_one: CEO in this role and industry for more than half their career
mgmt_fit.minus_one: Different role or industry for more than half their career

ceo_ownership.label: CEO ownership
ceo_ownership.plus_one: Stock held / average total annual comp > 3x
ceo_ownership.evidence_hint: Proxy beneficial ownership table and summary compensation table.

incentive_comp_metrics.label: Incentive comp metrics (ICMQ)
incentive_comp_metrics.evidence_hint: Weights: ROIC 100%, relative TSR and FCF per share 50%, absolute TSR, FCF, margins and other per-share 25%.

incentive_comp_payout.label: Incentive comp payout
incentive_comp_payout.plus_one: Payout < 100% with relative TSR positive, or < 80%
incentive_comp_payout.minus_one: Payout > 150%, or > 80% with relative TSR negative

governance.label: Governance
governance.evidence_hint: Board independence, share classes, related-party items.

competitor_behavior.label: Competitor behavior
competitor_behavior.evidence_hint: Price wars, capacity additions, rational or irrational rivals.

industry_cyclicality.label: Industry cyclicality
industry_cyclicality.plus_one: Demand and capital-supply cycles near trough

leverage.label: Leverage
leverage.evidence_hint: Debt, leases and pension obligations against earnings power.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.plus_one: FCF coverage of 5y maturities, facilities and dividends > 2x
liquidity.evidence_hint: Debt maturity schedule and cash flow statement.

shared_value.label: Shared value
shared_value.evidence_hint: Whether customers, employees and society benefit alongside owners.

research_stage.label: Research stage
research_stage.plus_one: Followed closely for more than a year
research_stage.minus_one: Still under review, or too hard to forecast
research_stage.evidence_hint: About the analyst's own coverage history, not the company.

fundamental_thesis.label: Fundamental thesis
fundamental_thesis.evidence_hint: Only meaningful against a prior review.

non_gaap_adjustments.label: Non-GAAP adjustments
non_gaap_adjustments.evidence_hint: Size and direction of adjustments between GAAP and reported non-GAAP figures.

rotic_trend.label: ROTIC trend
rotic_trend.evidence_hint: Direction of ROTIC over the window.

rotic_estimate_trend.label: ROTIC estimate trend
rotic_estimate_trend.evidence_hint: Needs consensus estimates. Usually N/A without a data vendor.

metrics.NOPAT: GAAP EBIT + acquired intangible amortization + interest component of operating lease expense - taxes at a normalized rate + equity income after tax - income attributable to NCI after tax
metrics.TICAP: Total assets - cash - goodwill - indefinite-lived intangibles - non-interest-bearing current liabilities
metrics.ROIIC: (sum NOPAT years 0-4 - sum NOPAT years 10-14) / (avg TICAP years 0-5 - avg TICAP years 10-15); thresholds > 15% good, < 5% bad
metrics.financials_note: Banks and insurers use iROE (net income to common / tangible common equity excluding AOCI) instead of ROTIC. Say so in the report.

rollup.category_score: Mean of the category's scored (non-null) criteria, 1 decimal
rollup.weighted_average: Sum(weight x category score) / sum(weights of scored categories), 2 decimals. Lead with this number.
rollup.normalized_pct: ((weighted_average + 1) / 2) x 100. An inference about the original sheet, label it as such.
rollup.percent_of_max_pct: max(weighted_average, 0) x 100. Also an inference. Show both percentages or neither.
rollup.coverage: Always show scored / in scope and list the N/A criteria by name.

disclaimer: Not financial or legal advice. Scores under the BOFFIN framework only. Valuation is not scored.
